title: Quantitative Trait Loci Identification and Candidate Genes Characterization for Indole-3-Carbinol Content in Seedlings of Brassica napus.
authors: Xiong, Yiyi; Li, Huaixin; Fan, Shipeng; Ding, Yiran; Wu, Mingli; He, Jianjie; Yan, Shuxiang; Jia, Haibo; Li, Maoteng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过QTL定位和共表达分析鉴定调控甘蓝型油菜幼苗吲哚-3-甲醇含量的转录因子，并用分子对接验证I3M与IGMT的结合，虽涉及TF-DNA调控网络和分子对接，但核心是遗传定位而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Brassica napus is a member of the cruciferous family with rich glucosinolate (GSL) content, particularly glucobrassicin (3-indolylmethyl glucosinolate, I3M), that can be metabolized into indole-3-carbinol (I3C), a compound with promising anticancer properties. To unravel the genetic mechanism influencing I3C content in rapeseed seedlings, a comprehensive study was undertaken with a doubled haploid (DH) population. By quantitative trait loci (QTL) mapping, seven QTL that were located on A01, A07, and C04 were identified, with the most significant contribution to phenotypic variation observed on chromosome A07 (11.78%). The genes within the QTL confidence intervals (CIs) include transcription factors (TFs) and glycosyltransferases. After co-expression analysis, GSL-related regulatory network of TFs-targets was constructed and two TFs, BnaA07.ERF019 and BnaA07.NAC92, were identified as possible regulators in GSL biosynthesis. Three IGMT (glucosinolate methyltransferases) genes were found within the CIs that expressed higher in seedlings with more I3C, indicating their roles in I3C synthesis regulation. Molecular docking studies validated the binding capability of I3M to IGMTs, and those within the I3C QTL CIs have the strongest binding energy. These new discoveries offer critical insights into the genetic regulation of I3C content in rapeseed seedlings and establish a foundation for breeding high-I3C rapeseed varieties with potential health-promoting properties.
abstract_zh: 欧洲油菜（Brassica napus）是十字花科植物的一员，富含硫代葡萄糖苷（glucosinolate, GSL），特别是葡萄糖芸苔素（3-吲哚甲基硫代葡萄糖苷, I3M），其可代谢为吲哚-3-甲醇（indole-3-carbinol, I3C），一种具有前景的抗癌特性的化合物。为揭示影响油菜幼苗中I3C含量的遗传机制，利用双单倍体（doubled haploid, DH）群体开展了一项综合研究。通过数量性状位点（quantitative trait loci, QTL）定位，鉴定出位于A01、A07和C04上的七个QTL，其中对表型变异贡献最显著的是位于A07染色体上的QTL（11.78%）。QTL置信区间（confidence intervals, CIs）内的基因包括转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）和糖基转移酶。经共表达分析，构建了GSL相关的TF-靶基因调控网络，并鉴定出两个转录因子BnaA07.ERF019和BnaA07.NAC92，可能作为GSL生物合成的调控因子。在CIs内发现三个IGMT（硫代葡萄糖苷甲基转移酶）基因，在I3C含量较高的幼苗中表达量更高，表明它们在I3C合成调控中发挥作用。分子对接研究验证了I3M与IGMTs的结合能力，其中位于I3C QTL CIs内的IGMTs具有最强的结合能。这些新发现为油菜幼苗中I3C含量的遗传调控提供了重要见解，并为培育具有潜在健康促进特性的高I3C油菜品种奠定了基础。
